design: Resolve and validate the one current bound policy via installed canonical capabilities, with current manifest/build freshness checked.
Have bo_create obtain that canonical policy/build binding for both live bootstrap and native tests; options.policyHash becomes a checked expected value, never an overriding source.
Remove the review/policy-fingerprint.json fallback, preserving that old artifact as historical evidence. Do not merely rewrite its value.
Use a small project adapter around the installed Python API or repair19 public binding/export API; do not implement JavaScript JSON canonicalization or re-evaluate native authorization.
Reject observer initialization if caller policy/build and canonical binding disagree. Preserve optional-observer startup so native business execution survives observer absence.
After repair19 installation, implement source binding, refresh managed/source review, run normal tests and complete new recording with a newly attested build; never rewrite old event hashes.
